waiting.asleepText: The dongle is connected but the mouse didn't answer. Move or click the mouse to wake it up; the app retries on its own.
waiting.text: Connect the dongle or the cable. If A HUB is open, close it, since both can't use the mouse at the same time.

dpi.title: Sensitivity
dpi.description: Set the DPI stages the mouse's DPI± buttons cycle through.
dpi.range: From 50 to 26,000 DPI, in steps of 10.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: How many times per second the mouse reports its position to the PC.
performance.pollingNote: Rates above 1 kHz need the high-speed dongle.
performance.tip: 1–2 kHz for everyday use. 4–8 kHz cut latency by a few tenths of a millisecond but use much more battery and CPU.

sensor.title: Sensor
sensor.motionSyncDesc: Syncs sensor reads with polling. Smoother movement, about 1 ms more delay.
sensor.linearDesc: Angle snapping: straightens strokes that should be straight.
sensor.rippleDesc: Smooths sensor noise at high DPI.
sensor.glassDesc: Improves tracking on glass surfaces. Turn it off on regular mouse pads.
sensor.debounceDesc: How long the mouse waits to confirm a click. Low values respond faster; high values prevent accidental double clicks.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Pick a button on the mouse or in the menu and choose what it does.
buttons.locked: Scrolling uses a function code that hasn't been decoded yet. For safety, it can't be changed here.
buttons.extraKeys: Extra keys F13–F24, which no keyboard has and are great for shortcuts
buttons.leftWarning: Changing the left click can make the mouse hard to use.
